result.description:
Implementation & Activation Associate Director
WPP AUNZ–Barangaroo NSW
This is a role at WPP Media which is part of the WPP network.
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $95,000 - $120,000 inclusive of superannuation
Location: Office location will be determined dependent on the right applicant, as we have offices based in Sydney, Melbourne, Adelaide, Perth and Brisbane

About WPP Media

WPP Media is the leading global media investment management company serving as the parent to WPP media agencies including Mindshare, EssenceMediacom, Wavemaker, Choreograph and GOAT. With 1,000+ people based across Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide and Perth, WPP Media’s primary purpose is to maximize performance of WPP’s agencies by operating as leader and collaborator in trading, content creation, sports, digital, finance, proprietary tool development and other business-critical capabilities. WPP Media’s focus is to deliver unrivalled advantage to its clients, stakeholders, and people. Combined with WPP Media’s global scale, our media investment decisions—guided by brand safety, leading privacy principles and premium relationships— represent 1 out of 3 ads in the global marketplace. Through modern investment services, we put money against goals that move businesses forward.

Implementation & Activation

The Implementation & Activation team is responsible for delivering best-in-class media planning and buying for our award-winning agency brands.

The scope of the Implementation & Activation team covers all media channels and touchpoints, with a focus on delivering omnichannel media plans in each of our client patches and brands. Sitting centrally alongside our Implementation & Activation team is our Centre of Excellence, housing the Media Operations team and Craft Heads.

With our collective industry expertise, we navigate the ever-changing media landscape efficiently and effectively, fuelling growth for the brands we work with. Our commitment to transparency and accountability drives best-in-class results consistently, leveraging our exceptional media relationships to keep our finger on the pulse of emerging opportunities.

Role Outline

The Implementation & Activation Associate Director is an emerging leadership role, overseeing operational excellence and responsible for all day-to-day output that delivers effective campaigns, ensuring best-in-class consistent implementation, optimisation, and reporting. Working very closely with your Director, you will produce best-in-class solutions, offer unparalleled service and deliver against targets.
The role involves the development and application of specialist technical skills, and effective team leadership.

Key Responsibilities

CLIENTS
Cultivate strong, trusted relationships with clients at a mid to senior level
Offer expert perspectives and POVs on recent market trends or developments, ensuring they're shared with key stakeholders regularly.
Regularly meet with vendors and partners to drive your client's agenda, creating opportunities for your team members to get involved and engage.
Maintain an in-depth understanding of client challenges, objectives & initiatives, and be able to clearly articulate these to your team and your media partners.
Focus on building our outstanding client service reputation
Robust understanding of the in-scope services of your clients and the process for completing work above and beyond
Proactively recommend tactics and opportunities that resolve client challenges and objectives.

PRODUCT
Brings innovation and creativity to the table, leveraging market insights.
When required, a strict adherence to activation commitments that have client contract association. 
Able to construct and present effective and future facing Implementation plans, that are grounded in strategic priorities and data-led optimisation recommendations. 
Maintain an in-depth knowledge of the media landscape, able to confidently articulate and train others on media principles and how each media touchpoint can fuel growth for clients.
Collaborate closely with internal product teams including WPP Media proprietary product and service teams to ensure you can clearly articulate the benefits of their inclusion, with a focus on identifying growth opportunities that can transform outcomes.
Seek to find, communicate and implement improvements in all aspects of the role.
A pivotal role for client media audits, negotiations and billings forecasting, working hand in hand with your key stakeholders to deliver client KPI’s.

PEOPLE
Motivate and empower direct reports to achieve individual, team and organisational goals. 
Conduct fortnightly 1:1s, annual Career Conversations and Performance Reviews with direct reports.
Liaise with the People Team to resolve any team disputes to ensure a safe and productive team environment. 
Continuously champion company values to build strong and trusted connections, solution-oriented perspectives and demonstrate that you genuinely care for collective team success.
 
GROWH & MARKETING
Identify, collate and showcase examples of great work from within the team, both internally and externally.
Build the agency’s reputation by contributing to entries for awards and competitions and by contributing to industry thought leadership.
Actively contribute to new business development and pitching as needed.

REQUIRED CAPABILITIES
You feel empowered to bring your authentic self to work, and contribute to great teamwork, knowing your individual ideas and thoughts will be welcome.
Keen interest in our industry and excited to work with market leading partners & technologies.
Inquisitive and demonstrates desire to understand and know more. 
Ability to prioritise tasks effectively, ensuring that the most important and urgent ones are identified and addressed first. 
Results driven with the ability to identify and clearly articulate what’s working and why. 
Problem solving mentality. Attention to detail. Clear communicator.
